standard.$description: A restrained, mostly-linear ease-out — deliberately not a pronounced curve, matching the snappy/utilitarian decision.

bottom-sheet.$description: Above overlay/sticky, below modal — a Modal opened over a sheet must still win, and popover/tooltip opened from inside a sheet win by being higher still. Blade puts its sheet at the page-chrome tier (100) for the same reason.

popover.$description: Above modal/toast (can hold interactive content), below tooltip — a tooltip triggered from inside an open popover must still win.

tooltip.$description: Highest in the scale — a tooltip must be able to render above everything, including a toast. Matches Blade's own real default (1100, also its own scale's highest value) in relative position, not absolute number.
